brief:
Israeli forces shot and killed 29-year-old Mahmoud Mohammad Suleiman near Beit Ur al-Tahta, west of Ramallah in the central occupied West Bank on Wednesday, IMEMC News reported. The shooting followed what Israeli police described as a car-ramming incident.

An Israeli reservist was seriously wounded in the ramming, according to the report. No further details on the circumstances surrounding the incident were immediately available.
